Recomputed eigenvalues as Rayleigh quotients from the exact input and exact-replay Q, using the existing BF16x9 square product for AQ and a fused per-column dot kernel. Replaced approximate BF16x9 AQ-based values with one terminal direct Rayleigh grid: one CTA per eigenvector, coalesced warp row products, and FP64 inner/outer accumulation against the original A. All 39 local cases pass in 159.7 s and n512 clustered improves from scaled 1330 to 96.6. The full official benchmark still fails rare matrices in every persistent shape (scaled 312-4030 across dense/mixed/rankdef/clustered), showing the remaining issue is native two-term A evolution changing Q, not value extraction; benchmark aborted after 83.5 s.

Kept TCGEN05 for A_hi*(R_hi+R_lo), then reused the packed shared factor tile for exact A_low and accumulated A_low*(R_hi+R_lo) with scalar FP32 FMAs before TMEM writeback. Packed A_low into the native K-major descriptor, issued A_low*R_high through a second sm100a TCGEN05 MMA into a separate TMEM accumulator after the high-term commit, and summed both TMEM tiles at writeback while retaining exact compact Q. Validation takes 155.5 s but only 23/39 cases pass; residuals reach scaled 2160 and high/low magnitude cases fail. The retained second accumulator/layout remains numerically invalid even with exact Q.

Ordinary official n512/n1024 batches pass, but six large-batch stress shapes retain rare failures at scaled 261-1430; official run aborts after 163.4 s. Applied a second full exact compact sweep to the same Q^T A Q projection, without another projection or workspace.
